caveats:
Adm3 covers towns, districts and neighborhoods

23 English names are translated to multiple Arabic names in the Admin 2 layer; there is not a 1:1 relationship between the English and Arabic names in the admin2 layer.

19 Admin2 units along the Nile have duplicate English names within the same Admin1 unit.   All of these features have unique Arabic names.

The Admin2 layer has 14 units with an Admin2 name of "Zemam Out" and each one belongs to a unique Admin1 unit.  However, there are no "Zemam Out" Admin2 units in the Admin3 layer.
dataset_source: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other: Dataset: Source data was provided by CAPMAS, government of Egypt.  CODs developed by OCHA with standard coding and classification system.  Processed by ITOS for verification, packaging, and live services.
name: cod-ab-egy
notes:
Egypt administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 27 Governorate  
- Admin 2: 365 Region  
- Admin 3: 5716 nan, partial coverage  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 19 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 21 April 2017: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 14 August 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 14 August 2017: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
